Test material for Personal Learning / AI indexing / Question Extraction
Topics Covered
• Percentages
• Profit and Loss
• Ratio and Proportion
• Averages
• Time and Work
• Time, Speed and Distance
• Simple and Compound Interest
• Number Systems
Study Notes
Percentages: Percentage means a value out of 100. Percentage change = (change/original) × 100.
Profit and Loss: Profit = Selling Price − Cost Price. Loss = Cost Price − Selling Price. Profit% =
Profit/Cost Price × 100.
Ratio: A ratio compares quantities using the same units. If a:b = m:n, then a/b = m/n.
Average: Average = Sum of observations / Number of observations.
Time and Work: If a person completes a job in x days, their one-day work is 1/x.
Speed: Speed = Distance / Time.
Simple Interest: SI = (P × R × T) / 100.
Compound Interest: Amount = P(1 + R/100)^T and CI = Amount − Principal.
Number Systems: For two positive integers, HCF × LCM = Product of the numbers.
Practice Questions
Q1. [Percentages] A student's marks increase from 60 to 75. What is the percentage increase?
A. 15%
B. 20%
C. 25%
D. 30%
Q2. [Percentages] A number is increased by 20% and then decreased by 20%. What is the net
percentage change?
A. 0%
B. 4% decrease
C. 4% increase
D. 2% decrease
Q3. [Profit and Loss] An article costs n800 and is sold for n920. What is the profit percentage?
A. 10%
B. 12%
C. 15%
D. 20%
Q4. [Profit and Loss] A shopkeeper gives a 10% discount on an item marked n1,500. What is the
selling price?
A. n1,300
B. n1,350
C. n1,400
D. n1,450
Q5. [Ratio and Proportion] The ratio of boys to girls is 3:2. If there are 30 boys, how many girls are
there?
A. 15
B. 18
C. 20
D. 24
Q6. [Averages] The average of 5 numbers is 24. What is their total?
A. 100
B. 110
C. 120
D. 125
Q7. [Averages] The average age of 4 students is 18. With a fifth student, the average becomes 19. What
is the fifth student's age?
A. 21
B. 22
C. 23
D. 24
Q8. [Time and Work] A can complete a job in 10 days and B in 15 days. How many days together?
A. 5
B. 6
C. 7
D. 8
Q9. [Time and Work] A worker completes 1/4 of a job in 3 days. How many days for the full job?
A. 8
B. 10
C. 12
D. 15
Q10. [Time, Speed and Distance] A car travels 180 km in 3 hours. What is its average speed?
A. 50 km/h
B. 55 km/h
C. 60 km/h
D. 65 km/h
Q11. [Time, Speed and Distance] A train travels at 72 km/h. How far in 25 minutes?
A. 25 km
B. 30 km
C. 32 km
D. 36 km
Q12. [Simple Interest] Find SI on n5,000 at 8% per annum for 2 years.
A. n600
B. n700
C. n800
D. n900
Q13. [Compound Interest] What is the amount on n10,000 at 10% compound interest for 2 years?
A. n11,000
B. n12,000
C. n12,100
D. n12,200
Q14. [Number Systems] What is the HCF of 36 and 48?
A. 6
B. 8
C. 12
D. 16
Q15. [Number Systems] What is the LCM of 12 and 18?
A. 24
B. 30
C. 36
D. 48
Answer Key and Explanations
Q1 — Answer: C
Increase = 15. Percentage increase = 15/60 × 100 = 25%.
Q2 — Answer: B
Take 100: after +20% it becomes 120; after −20% it becomes 96. Net change = 4% decrease.
Q3 — Answer: C
Profit = n120. Profit% = 120/800 × 100 = 15%.
Q4 — Answer: B
Discount = n150. Selling price = n1,350.
Q5 — Answer: C
3 parts = 30, so 1 part = 10. Girls = 2 parts = 20.
Q6 — Answer: C
Total = 24 × 5 = 120.
Q7 — Answer: C
Original total = 72. New total = 95. Fifth age = 23.
Q8 — Answer: B
1/10 + 1/15 = 1/6, so they need 6 days.
Q9 — Answer: C
3 × 4 = 12 days.
Q10 — Answer: C
Speed = 180/3 = 60 km/h.
Q11 — Answer: B
72 km/h = 1.2 km/min. 1.2 × 25 = 30 km.
Q12 — Answer: C
SI = 5000 × 8 × 2 / 100 = n800.
Q13 — Answer: C
Amount = 10,000 × 1.1² = n12,100.
Q14 — Answer: C
The greatest common factor is 12.
Q15 — Answer: C
LCM = 2² × 3² = 36.
